FO2727: Forté Occasional Table with Wood Base
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-fo2727-forte-occasional-table-laminate-top-wood-base-n700162
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-occasional-table/
Spec sheets: FO2727 Forté Occasional Table, Wood Base, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Occasional Table with Laminate Top and Wood Base – FO2727
Current H1: Norix Forté Durable Occasional Table with Laminate Top and Wood Base - FO2727
Subtitle: 27” Square Laminate-Top Lounge Table on a Solid Hardwood Base That Gangs with Forté Lounge Chairs
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series FO2727 Occasional Table with Laminated Top and Wood Base
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Occasional Table with Wood Base is a 27” square, 13.5” high laminate-top table on a solid hardwood base with tapered legs, for a warm, residential look in lounges and waiting areas. It can stand alone or be ganged with Forté lounge chairs as an intermediate or corner table.
The high-pressure laminate top has a radiused polyurethane edge that is pressure fused to the top, so it stays sanitary and pick resistant, and embedded T-nuts secure it to the 3” solid hardwood frame, which is joined with glued mortise and tenon joints.
Top: Decorative high-pressure laminate bonded to a 45 lb density particle board core with embedded T-nuts
Edge: Radiused polyurethane edge, pressure fused to the top so it is firmly attached and sanitary
Base: 3” solid hardwood frame with tapered legs and glued mortise and tenon joints
Overall Size: 27”W×27”D×13.5”H
Weight: 47.5 lbs
Laminate Top Colors: Titanium Evolve, Wild Cherry, Kensington Maple, Asian Sun, Montana Walnut, Palisades Oak, Calcutta Marble, or Black Alicante
Base Colors: Maple, Teak, or Walnut
Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,000 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”)
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for the top; a mild wood cleaner for routine cleaning of the base, and a regular-strength wood cleaner for tougher stains and marks
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
FO2727 – Wood Base: 27”×27” laminate top, 47.5 lbs
Options: Ganging kit (C011-021)
Installation and Options
Assembly: None required
Ganging: Installation required for ganging plates
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Occasional Table with Wood Base suits lounges and waiting areas where a warmer, residential look matters.
Typical applications include:
Lounges, family rooms, and visitation areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Lobbies and waiting rooms
Visitation rooms and staff areas in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Forté Furniture" section as the FC600 tab.
Prices checked: $1,050.40 is 80% of the Norix list price of $1,313 (compare-at $1,313). No change.
Colors: the current page lists "Base/leg colors: Sienna, Dove, Raven" (the molded base colors) as well as Maple, Teak, and Walnut. The wood base comes only in Maple, Teak, and Walnut. Corrected.
Bolt-down: the current page lists a "Bolt-Down Plate" option, but the wood base spec sheet lists no options and the price list shows only the ganging kit (C011-021, $50 list) for the wood base. I left the bolt-down plate out. Is it available for the wood base?
Edge thickness: the current page says 1¾”, but the spec sheet gives 3.2 cm, which is about 1¼”. I left the edge thickness out until it is confirmed.
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (row 210: 47.5 / 27 / 27 / 13.5).
Images: the 5 current images are kept (3 tables and 2 color charts). No new photos to suggest.
Collections: the table is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. I added a Transitional Housing Furniture link, since all seven Forté products are in that collection.
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Forté section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
